{{recipe}}

In Italy they will just mix creamy light cheeses like mascarpone with just a bare bit of sugar, egg yolk custard, sweet spices, citrus zest, and chocolate. If you have ever tried one of these cheese desserts, you'll know that they're very good.

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]], [[Cookbook:Beating|beaten]]
* ¼ cup granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone cheese]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* [[Cookbook:Chocolate Syrup|Chocolate syrup]]
* Crushed vanilla [[Cookbook:Cookie|cookies]] and semi-sweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] curls for topping
* Barely-sweetened [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]]
* [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|Cocoa powder]]
== Procedure ==

=== Cream mixture ===
#[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] yolks and sugar in a stainless steel bowl until light and creamy.
#Place the bowl on top of a pot of 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] simmering water to create a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].
#Whisk yolks non-stop, until warmed, thickened, and falling off the whisk in ribbons. Set aside until needed.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] together egg yolks, mascarpone, cream, and vanilla. 

=== Serving ===
# Pour a small amount of chocolate syrup into the bottom of a glass dish.
# Fill with cheese mixture.
# Top with crushed cookies and chocolate curls. Refrigerate before serving.
# Place a serving portion into each plate. Smooth out into a small rectangle.
# Place a dollop of whipped cream on top, and dust the whole thing with cocoa powder.
